meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: Claude 会作为向导,带新用户走完 omo 的首次对话:功能导览、可选的迁移帮助、旧会话分析、价值估算、全程随时记录记忆,以及首次会话的 init-deep 提议。
howto.when: 当新用户提出想开始使用 omo 时触发。这套导览只会自动启动一次,之后可用 `senpi --onboard` 重新调出,或用 `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled` 关掉自动启动。

say.text: 我想开始用 omo,带我过一遍基本流程
say.note: 进入首次导览,依次走各环节

say.text: 我是从 Claude Code 过来的,帮我把配置迁过来
say.note: 进入迁移环节,先给出方案等你确认

say.text: 看看我以前的编码会话,算算用 omo 能省多少
say.note: 进入会话考古与价值估算,结果标为 estimate

howto.what_en: Claude guides a new omo user's first conversation: a feature tour, optional migration help, session archaeology, value estimates, ongoing memory recording, and a first-session init-deep proposal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. The tour auto-starts only once ever; it can be brought back with the `senpi --onboard` flag or shut off with `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled`.

say_en.text: I'm new to omo, walk me through the basics
say_en.note: Starts the onboarding lanes in order

say_en.text: I'm coming from Claude Code, migrate my setup
say_en.note: Shows a migration plan and waits for approval

say_en.text: Look at my past coding sessions and estimate my savings
say_en.note: Runs session archaeology plus value mapping
